course: Accounting and Finance ATAR (Units 3–4; 2020–2025 past questions mapped to the 2026–2027 syllabus)

topic_codes.FRM: Companies and the financial reporting framework
topic_codes.EQT: Share capital, dividends and equity records
topic_codes.OUT: Historical content outside the current syllabus

patterns.name_zh: 比较管理会计与财务会计
patterns.definition: Distinguish accounting for internal decisions from accounting for external reporting by purpose, users and outputs.
patterns.not: Preparing a budget belongs to BUD; reporting-entity requirements belong to FRM.

patterns.name_zh: 分类、说明与选择融资产品
patterns.definition: Identify, describe or select a financial product using its maturity, security, ownership or purpose.
patterns.not: Recording shares belongs to EQT; a capital-project appraisal belongs to INV. A superseded instrument name needs a historical note.

patterns.name_en: Apply principles of asset and funding management
patterns.name_zh: 应用资产与资金管理原则
patterns.definition: Relate non-current assets, receivables, inventory, cash, short- and long-term debt and appropriate equity capital to the resources and funding the business requires.
patterns.not: Numerical profitability or gearing ratios belong to RAT; calculating asset cash flows belongs to CSH.

patterns.name_en: Explain cash requirements for business viability
patterns.name_zh: 解释现金对企业持续经营的意义
patterns.definition: Explain how available cash supports payment obligations, ongoing operations and business development.
patterns.not: A cash-budget calculation belongs to BUD; interpreting a prepared cash-flow statement belongs to CSH.

patterns.name_zh: 提出现金管理控制措施
patterns.definition: Describe a practical cash-management action and connect it to the business cash-management objective.
patterns.not: Do not award this pattern merely for an arithmetic cash balance; budget construction is BUD.

patterns.name_en: Classify direct, indirect, product and period costs
patterns.name_zh: 分类直接、间接、产品与期间成本
patterns.definition: Identify or explain cost classification by traceability to a cost object or by manufacturing versus period function, with the requested example.
patterns.not: Behaviour as activity changes belongs to CST2; total cost arithmetic belongs to CST4–CST8.

patterns.name_en: Explain fixed and variable cost behaviour
patterns.name_zh: 解释固定与变动成本的性态
patterns.definition: Identify or explain fixed, variable and mixed cost behaviour, including the behaviour of overheads in the specified activity range.
patterns.not: A direct cost is not automatically variable. The profit or break-even effect of changing costs belongs to CVP9.

patterns.name_zh: 区分历史成本与未来成本
patterns.definition: Explain the distinction between incurred past costs and future costs useful for planning and decision making.
patterns.not: A relevant-cost comparison between specific alternatives belongs to CVP6–CVP8.

patterns.name_zh: 计算直接材料成本
patterns.definition: Use material quantities and prices, packaging and the required production basis to calculate material cost for a batch or unit.
patterns.not: Changes against standard input or price belong to CST10–CST11; allocating all manufacturing components belongs to CST8.

patterns.name_zh: 计算直接人工成本
patterns.definition: Use labour time, rates and production basis, converting minutes or periods where required, to calculate labour cost.
patterns.not: Labour used as the overhead allocation base belongs to CST6–CST7; rate and efficiency variances belong to CST12–CST13.

patterns.name_en: Determine manufacturing overhead and recovery rate
patterns.name_zh: 确定制造费用与分配率
patterns.definition: Select the manufacturing overhead pool and calculate the recovery rate from the specified allocation base; current tasks use predetermined rates at normal capacity.
patterns.not: Follow the stated base: labour hours and machine hours are not interchangeable. Applying the rate to a job belongs to CST7.

patterns.name_en: Apply overhead to a batch or unit
patterns.name_zh: 将制造费用分配至批次或单位
patterns.definition: Use the relevant job or unit activity, in the same units as the recovery rate, to allocate manufacturing overhead.
patterns.not: Deriving the recovery rate belongs to CST6; a business-region closure comparison belongs to CVP8.

patterns.name_en: Calculate batch and unit manufacturing cost
patterns.name_zh: 计算批次与单位制造成本
patterns.definition: Combine material, labour and overhead costs and use the batch or output count to calculate manufacturing cost per batch or unit.
patterns.not: Calculating only one cost component belongs to CST4–CST7. Selling-price mark-up belongs to CST9. A component amount included inside a whole-unit cost task stays CST8.

patterns.name_en: Use and explain cost mark-up pricing
patterns.name_zh: 应用与解释成本加成定价
patterns.definition: Use the specified unit cost and mark-up on cost to calculate selling price or explain the pricing relationship with an example.
patterns.not: Mark-up on cost is not margin on selling price. Solving a contribution-and-profit equation belongs to CVP10.

patterns.name_zh: 计算材料价格差异
patterns.definition: Compare actual and standard materials prices using actual quantity, and determine the favourable or unfavourable result.
patterns.not: Quantity against standard input belongs to CST11; do not substitute standard quantity in the price variance.

patterns.name_zh: 计算材料用量差异
patterns.definition: Compare actual input with the standard quantity allowed for actual output and apply the standard materials price.
patterns.not: Actual output determines allowed input; a price difference belongs to CST10.

patterns.name_zh: 计算人工工资率差异
patterns.definition: Compare actual and standard labour rates using actual labour hours and interpret the variance direction.
patterns.not: Time against allowed standard hours belongs to CST13.

patterns.name_zh: 计算人工效率差异
patterns.definition: Compare actual hours with the standard hours allowed for actual output and apply the standard labour rate, including deriving allowed hours when required.
patterns.not: A rate difference belongs to CST12; budget-versus-actual performance reports belong to BUD8.

patterns.name_en: Calculate total, unit contribution and contribution ratio
patterns.name_zh: 计算总边际贡献、单位贡献与贡献率
patterns.definition: Select selling price, variable costs and activity to identify or calculate total or unit contribution or its ratio to sales.
patterns.not: An allocated full-cost amount is not automatically variable cost; cost classification belongs to CST. Weighted multi-product contribution belongs to CVP3.

patterns.name_zh: 计算产品或业务活动组合比例
patterns.definition: Calculate a product or segment share of the specified total sales or activity base and apply that mix to a requested volume.
patterns.not: Use the stated base: kilometres are not sales dollars. Applying overhead rates in manufacturing belongs to CST.

patterns.name_zh: 计算加权平均边际贡献
patterns.definition: Combine each product contribution with its mix to calculate the weighted average contribution per composite unit.
patterns.not: The mix alone belongs to CVP2; the subsequent break-even calculation belongs to CVP4.

patterns.name_zh: 计算盈亏平衡或目标利润销量
patterns.definition: Identify or calculate required sales using fixed costs, the applicable contribution and a target profit where specified.
patterns.not: Margin of safety belongs to CVP5; interpreting a change in assumptions belongs to CVP9.

patterns.name_en: Calculate and explain margin of safety
patterns.name_zh: 计算与解释安全边际
patterns.definition: Calculate or explain the excess of actual or planned sales over break-even sales, with the units or percentage requested.
patterns.not: Do not confuse this sales cushion with the contribution earned on each unit in CVP1.

patterns.name_zh: 评价特殊订单
patterns.definition: Compare incremental revenue with relevant variable, additional fixed and opportunity costs and make the requested special-order decision.
patterns.not: Allocated unavoidable costs are not automatically incremental; component sourcing belongs to CVP7.

patterns.name_zh: 评价自制或外购方案
patterns.definition: Compare relevant costs of making and buying, identify avoidable costs and recommend the financially preferable option.
patterns.not: Do not count unchanged allocated costs as a saving. A new customer order belongs to CVP6.

patterns.name_zh: 评价业务部门盈利与关闭决策
patterns.definition: Prepare segment revenue and cost comparisons, distinguish retained and avoidable costs and assess the whole-business profit effect of closure.
patterns.not: A segment accounting loss alone does not prove closure benefits the business. Activity-mix proportions belong to CVP2.

patterns.name_zh: 解释成本、销量与利润的变化
patterns.definition: Trace how changing prices, activity, variable costs or fixed costs affects profit or break-even and link the result to the business context.
patterns.not: Merely computing the original break-even point belongs to CVP4; a formal financial-statement ratio effect belongs to RAT10.

patterns.name_zh: 求解本量利关系中的未知量
patterns.definition: Use the profit relationship to solve for selling price, variable cost, fixed cost, profit or activity under the specified conditions.
patterns.not: A prose explanation of a change belongs to CVP9; a specific break-even or target-profit sales calculation belongs to CVP4.

patterns.name_zh: 解释全面预算的组成与作用
patterns.definition: Identify operating, capital and financial budgets or explain how a budget supports planning, coordination and control.
patterns.not: Individual forecast calculations belong to BUD2–BUD7; actual-versus-budget performance belongs to BUD8.

patterns.name_zh: 编制预计客户收款计划
patterns.definition: Apply cash and credit sales proportions, collection lags and discounts to forecast customer receipts in the correct months.
patterns.not: Historical debtor reconciliation for a cash-flow statement belongs to CSH; deriving accrual sales for forecast profit belongs to BUD7.

patterns.name_zh: 编制预计供应商付款计划
patterns.definition: Apply purchases and payment timing to forecast cash paid to trade creditors in each budget period.
patterns.not: Do not treat purchase recognition as immediate cash payment without the timing data. Other expense payments belong to BUD4.

patterns.name_zh: 计算预计经营现金支出
patterns.definition: Calculate forecast wages, interest and other operating payments using the relevant period and adjustments, removing non-cash items such as depreciation and loss on disposal.
patterns.not: Budgeted accrual expenses belong to BUD7; capital purchases and financing movements belong to BUD5.

patterns.name_en: Record forecast capital and financing cash movements
patterns.name_zh: 列报预计投资与筹资现金变动
patterns.definition: Include asset purchases or disposal receipts, owner contributions, borrowings, net share proceeds and drawings in the forecast period.
patterns.not: Accounting disposal profit is not disposal cash proceeds. Company journal recording belongs to EQT rather than the cash budget.

patterns.name_zh: 计算与结转现金预算余额
patterns.definition: Use opening cash and the cash movements to obtain a closing balance and carry it correctly into the next period.
patterns.not: A printed unmarked balance is not an additional award. Interpreting a forecast shortage belongs to BUD9.

patterns.name_zh: 编制预计利润表
patterns.definition: Estimate accrual sales, income, expenses and tax for the forecast reporting period and prepare the budgeted profit statement.
patterns.not: Cash collection and payment timing alone belongs to BUD2–BUD5; historical external statements belong to STM.

patterns.name_en: Interpret performance reports and budget variances
patterns.name_zh: 解释业绩报告与预算差异
patterns.definition: Compare actual and budget figures, distinguish favourable from unfavourable changes and explain causes or a management response.
patterns.not: Standard material and labour variance calculations belong to CST; forecasting the original budget belongs to BUD2–BUD7.

patterns.name_en: Interpret a cash budget and recommend action
patterns.name_zh: 解释现金预算并建议应对措施
patterns.definition: Explain forecast shortages, surpluses or spending patterns and recommend a case-linked financing or cash-management response.
patterns.not: Naming a financial product without a budget implication belongs to FIN2. Historic ratio interpretation belongs to RAT.

patterns.name_en: Evaluate business planning and stakeholder consequences
patterns.name_zh: 评价企业规划与利益相关者影响
patterns.definition: Explain goals, resource allocation, costs, risks or stakeholder effects of the stated business decision using case evidence.
patterns.not: Generic use of the word sustainability does not establish climate-disclosure coverage. Numerical segment-closure analysis belongs to CVP8.

patterns.name_en: Apply cost leadership and differentiation strategies
patterns.name_zh: 应用成本领先与差异化战略
patterns.definition: Identify, explain or recommend cost leadership or differentiation in relation to the stated business case.
patterns.not: A numerical cost saving alone is not a strategy explanation. Removed generic strategy lists are not assumed current requirements.

patterns.name_zh: 编制预算业绩报告
patterns.definition: Prepare a cash-budget or budgeted-income performance report comparing actual and budget figures and calculating the required variances.
patterns.not: Explaining causes or management responses belongs to BUD8. The 2020–2025 selected award evidence does not establish a separate preparation award.

patterns.name_zh: 估算相关投资现金流
patterns.definition: Calculate project receipts, cash costs and capital outlays, removing non-cash depreciation and applying the specified income-tax effects to obtain relevant after-tax cash flows.
patterns.not: Preparing a company-wide historical cash-flow statement belongs to CSH. Discounting identified amounts belongs to INV3.

patterns.name_zh: 计算投资回收期
patterns.definition: Accumulate undiscounted project net cash flows, find unrecovered investment and convert the recovery fraction into the requested time units.
patterns.not: The inputs themselves belong to INV1; investment acceptance or a comparison with a payback limit belongs to INV4.

patterns.name_en: Discount project cash flows and calculate NPV
patterns.name_zh: 折现项目现金流并计算净现值
patterns.definition: Apply appropriate single-sum or annuity factors to dated inflows and outflows and compare their present values to calculate net present value.
patterns.not: Initial and residual cash-flow selection belongs to INV1. A positive-NPV recommendation belongs to INV4.

patterns.name_en: Recommend an investment using appraisal results
patterns.name_zh: 依据评估结果提出投资建议
patterns.definition: Choose or justify acceptance or a project alternative using NPV, payback and the decision constraints stated.
patterns.not: The greatest undiscounted receipt is not automatically the preferred project. Non-financial factors belong to INV5.

patterns.name_zh: 评价投资的非财务因素
patterns.definition: Identify and explain relevant non-financial considerations such as consumer preferences, competition or regulation and connect them to the capital-investment case.
patterns.not: A financial NPV or payback comparison belongs to INV4. Legal regulator identification belongs to GOV1.

patterns.name_en: Explain capital investment and time value of money
patterns.name_zh: 解释资本投资与货币时间价值
patterns.definition: Explain the nature and importance of long-term asset investment or why cash flows at different times have different present values.
patterns.not: Numerical discounting belongs to INV3; choosing a project from calculated results belongs to INV4.

patterns.name_en: Explain company structures and capital-raising requirements
patterns.name_zh: 解释公司形式与筹资要求
patterns.definition: Identify or compare company characteristics, ownership rights, liability and the capital-raising requirements asked for in the question.
patterns.not: Journal entries and share-application ledgers belong to EQT. Prospectus requirements follow the course scenario rather than a universal legal obligation for every company.

patterns.name_en: Explain company formation and internal rules
patterns.name_zh: 解释公司设立与内部规则
patterns.definition: Explain the formation requirements or the purpose and use of a written constitution and replaceable rules.
patterns.not: Identifying reporting regulators belongs to GOV. Insolvency procedures also belong to GOV.

patterns.name_en: Identify reporting entities and general-purpose reporting requirements
patterns.name_zh: 识别报告主体与通用财务报告要求
patterns.definition: Identify the reporting entity, external users and reporting objective, or distinguish the reporting requirements applying to the entities in the task.
patterns.not: The qualities of information belong to FRM4; preparing a particular statement belongs to STM or CSH.

patterns.name_en: Apply qualitative characteristics of financial information
patterns.name_zh: 应用财务信息的质量特征
patterns.definition: Identify, describe or apply fundamental and enhancing qualitative characteristics to the information being reported.
patterns.not: Do not replace an asset-definition or recognition argument with a list of qualities; that task is FRM5.

patterns.name_zh: 应用报表要素定义与确认条件
patterns.definition: Use the applicable Conceptual Framework element definition and recognition reasoning to decide how the item should be reported.
patterns.not: Routine balance-day arithmetic belongs to STM; historical terminology must be checked against the applicable framework.

patterns.name_en: Explain the purposes of accounting standards
patterns.name_zh: 解释会计准则的作用
patterns.definition: Explain how accounting standards support external users, comparable reporting, confidence or reporting duties.
patterns.not: A question asking which statutory body performs a role belongs to GOV. Calculating a statement item does not earn this pattern.

patterns.name_en: Explain the accountant role in business operations
patterns.name_zh: 解释会计人员在企业经营中的职责
patterns.definition: Describe an accountant responsibility in information collection, analysis, control, advice or reporting compliance.
patterns.not: An employee complying with regulation is not the regulator: identification of ASIC or other reporting bodies belongs to GOV.

patterns.name_zh: 比较内部与外部报告要求
patterns.definition: Compare internal and external reports by format, standards, timing, scope, users or audit requirements.
patterns.not: A simple identification of management versus financial accounting is FIN1; a cash/accrual comparison is FRM9.

patterns.name_zh: 区分现金制与权责发生制
patterns.definition: Explain or illustrate the difference between cash timing and accrual recognition of income or expenses.
patterns.not: Applying an adjustment while preparing a budget is BUD; preparing a financial statement adjustment is STM.

patterns.name_zh: 编制股份申请与配售分录
patterns.definition: Calculate share receipts and journalise receipt and allotment through applications, bank and ordinary share capital, with required narration.
patterns.not: Posting named ledger accounts belongs to EQT2. Payment and transfer of share issue costs belong to EQT3. Share-receipt calculations inside a named-ledger part belong to EQT2.

patterns.name_en: Post share receipts and allotment in ledgers
patterns.name_zh: 在总账中登记股份收款与配售
patterns.definition: Complete the bank, applications and ordinary share capital ledgers for the share issue, preserving the account viewpoint and debit or credit side.
patterns.not: An entry is described from the account being completed. Do not reverse it by using the counterpart account viewpoint; issue costs belong to EQT3.

patterns.name_en: Record and transfer share issue costs
patterns.name_zh: 登记与转销股份发行费用
patterns.definition: Journalise or post the cash payment of share issue costs and their transfer against share capital where requested.
patterns.not: An expense charge is not substituted for the specified equity treatment. Disclosure in statements or notes belongs to EQT7–EQT8.

patterns.name_en: Calculate and record a bonus share issue
patterns.name_zh: 计算与登记红股发行
patterns.definition: Determine shares eligible for a bonus issue, apply its ratio and value, and record or explain the reserve funding of the issue.
patterns.not: A bonus issue does not create cash receipts. Reporting a set of equity movements in a statement belongs to EQT7.

patterns.name_en: Calculate and record declared or paid dividends
patterns.name_zh: 计算与登记已宣告或已支付的股息
patterns.definition: Calculate the dividend from eligible shares and the stated rate and record declaration or payment through retained earnings, payable and bank.
patterns.not: Recommendation alone is not an active current journal requirement. Investor dividend-yield calculations belong to RAT5.

patterns.name_zh: 完成留存收益总账
patterns.definition: Post opening retained earnings, profit, dividends and reserve transfers and calculate the closing ledger balance.
patterns.not: Disclosure across all equity columns belongs to EQT7; the original profit calculation belongs to STM.

patterns.name_en: Prepare the statement of changes in equity
patterns.name_zh: 编制权益变动表
patterns.definition: Prepare the equity-column reconciliation for opening balances, profit, dividends, cash or bonus shares, issue costs, revaluation and reserve transfers.
patterns.not: Transfers between equity components are not new income or new total equity. Stand-alone ledger recording belongs to EQT1–EQT6.

patterns.name_zh: 编制权益与股息披露
patterns.definition: Present share counts, issue prices, net share capital, reserves and dividend amounts or rates in the requested financial-statement notes.
patterns.not: Notes are distinct from ledger postings and do not automatically award every unmarked balance. Non-equity asset disclosures belong to STM8.

patterns.name_zh: 编制利润及综合收益报表
patterns.definition: Present net sales, cost of sales, income and expense components in the required single-statement format for the reporting period.
patterns.not: Depreciation, allowance, tax and revaluation calculations belong to STM3–STM6. Forecast profit belongs to BUD7; the 2027 statement-title discrepancy is documented.

patterns.name_en: Prepare and classify the financial position
patterns.name_zh: 编制财务状况表并分类列报
patterns.definition: Select and calculate current or non-current assets, liabilities and equity for the statement of financial position, including net balances.
patterns.not: Element definitions and recognition arguments belong to FRM5. Separate asset notes belong to STM8.

patterns.name_en: Calculate depreciation for the reporting period
patterns.name_zh: 计算报告期折旧
patterns.definition: Apply straight-line or reducing-balance depreciation to the correct cost or carrying amount and the required fraction of the reporting period.
patterns.not: Merely displaying an already calculated accumulated balance belongs to STM8 or STM2. Removing non-cash expense for cash flow belongs to INV1 or CSH.

patterns.name_en: Calculate doubtful debts through the allowance
patterns.name_zh: 通过备抵账户计算坏账费用
patterns.definition: Reconcile opening allowance, bad debt write-offs and closing required allowance to determine doubtful debts expense.
patterns.not: Deducting an already supplied allowance from receivables belongs to STM2; do not equate write-offs with the full period expense.

patterns.name_en: Calculate income tax and after-tax profit
patterns.name_zh: 计算所得税与税后利润
patterns.definition: Use the relevant profit-before-tax amount and rate to calculate income tax and after-tax profit where required.
patterns.not: A source arithmetic typo is recorded rather than reproduced as a new mark; historical cash tax payment belongs to CSH6.

patterns.name_zh: 计算与列报重估增值
patterns.definition: Use the specified asset value and carrying amount to calculate or present a revaluation gain in the asset or comprehensive-income report.
patterns.not: An equity-reserve movement belongs to EQT7; routine cost and accumulated-depreciation notes belong to STM8.

patterns.name_zh: 识别与解释财务报表
patterns.definition: Identify a company statement and explain the information it communicates to the user specified.
patterns.not: A detailed ratio argument belongs to RAT; a statement calculation belongs to the applicable preparation pattern.

patterns.name_en: Prepare property, plant and equipment notes
patterns.name_zh: 编制不动产、厂房与设备附注
patterns.definition: Present asset cost or revalued amount and accumulated depreciation in the requested asset disclosures.
patterns.not: New depreciation calculations belong to STM3; share, reserve and dividend disclosures belong to EQT8.

patterns.name_zh: 应用期末调整与费用分类
patterns.definition: Identify or apply the accrual, prepayment, income-in-advance or expense classification required by a balance-day adjustment.
patterns.not: Historical cost of a preliminary item is not automatically an asset. Element-recognition reasoning belongs to FRM5; forecast adjustments belong to BUD7.

patterns.name_zh: 解释现金与现金等价物
patterns.definition: Identify or explain cash and qualifying cash equivalents and provide an example consistent with the liquidity, maturity and risk conditions.
patterns.not: Physical notes and coins are cash rather than removed finance-product notes. A deposit or overdraft is not universally a cash equivalent without the relevant conditions.

patterns.name_zh: 调节客户现金收款
patterns.definition: Reconcile opening and closing receivables with credit sales, returns, discounts and write-offs as given, then include cash sales where required.
patterns.not: Forecast collection-lag schedules belong to BUD2; calculating an efficiency ratio belongs to RAT2.

patterns.name_zh: 调节供应商现金付款
patterns.definition: Derive purchases from inventory and cost of sales, then reconcile opening and closing payables to determine supplier cash payments.
patterns.not: A purchase amount alone is not necessarily cash paid. Forecast payment schedules belong to BUD3.

patterns.name_zh: 调节其他经营现金付款
patterns.definition: Adjust operating expenses for opening and closing prepayments or accruals and remove relevant non-cash items to obtain cash payments.
patterns.not: Interest and tax have their own reconciliation patterns CSH5–CSH6. Forecast expense payments belong to BUD4.

patterns.name_zh: 计算利息收款与付款
patterns.definition: Determine cash interest receipts or payments using principal and rate or reconcile interest income or expense with accrued balances.
patterns.not: Accrual interest classification alone belongs to STM1; forecast interest cash belongs to BUD4.

patterns.name_zh: 确定现金所得税付款
patterns.definition: Identify or reconcile the cash tax payment reported for the period rather than simply using income tax expense.
patterns.not: Profit-based income tax calculation belongs to STM5. The accrual and cash values need not agree.

patterns.name_en: Reconcile asset and investment purchase payments
patterns.name_zh: 调节资产与投资购买付款
patterns.definition: Reconcile relevant asset accounts and exclude revaluations or other non-cash movements to determine cash paid for assets or investments.
patterns.not: An increase in carrying amount is not automatically a cash purchase. Disposal proceeds belong to CSH8; project appraisal belongs to INV.

patterns.name_zh: 确定资产处置现金收入
patterns.definition: Use asset cost, accumulated depreciation and gain or loss on disposal to determine actual disposal proceeds.
patterns.not: Disposal gain or loss is not itself the cash receipt; acquiring an asset belongs to CSH7.

patterns.name_zh: 调节筹资现金变动
patterns.definition: Determine cash share proceeds, issue costs, borrowing movements and dividends paid using relevant account reconciliations.
patterns.not: Bonus issues and reserve transfers do not create cash receipts. Equity statement recording belongs to EQT7.

patterns.name_en: Reconcile opening and closing cash totals
patterns.name_zh: 调节期初与期末现金总额
patterns.definition: Combine the relevant cash and qualifying equivalent balances for the statement cash reconciliation at each reporting date.
patterns.not: The examples must satisfy CSH1 conditions rather than treating every term deposit as qualifying.

patterns.name_en: Explain the benefits of cash-flow information
patterns.name_zh: 解释现金流量信息的用途
patterns.definition: Identify and explain how cash-flow information helps the specified user evaluate cash generation, obligations, activity or profit-versus-cash differences.
patterns.not: An actual case-based assessment of reported movements belongs to CSH12; alternative any-N key responses are not extra attainable marks.

patterns.name_en: Interpret cash-flow categories and business implications
patterns.name_zh: 解释现金流类别与企业影响
patterns.definition: Classify or analyse operating, investing and financing cash-flow evidence and explain the business implications of the reported movements.
patterns.not: Dividend classifications follow the applicable course booklet; do not infer the company generates sufficient cash from profit alone.

patterns.name_zh: 计算与识别流动性比率
patterns.definition: Identify the formula or what the current or quick asset ratio expresses, or select inputs and calculate it.
patterns.not: Explaining debt-paying capacity from the results belongs to RAT6; insolvency is GOV6.

patterns.name_zh: 计算与识别效率比率
patterns.definition: Identify what the debtor collection period or inventory turnover measures, or calculate the ratio with suitable average balances and sales or cost inputs.
patterns.not: Benchmark comparisons and management responses belong to RAT7. A budget collection schedule belongs to BUD.

patterns.name_zh: 计算与识别盈利能力比率
patterns.definition: Identify or calculate profit ratio, return on assets or times interest earned using the course formula and required balances.
patterns.not: Preparing statement profit belongs to STM; predicting a transaction effect on a ratio belongs to RAT10.

patterns.name_en: Calculate and identify financial stability ratios
patterns.name_zh: 计算与识别财务稳健性比率
patterns.definition: Identify or calculate the debt-to-equity leverage ratio with the course definition.
patterns.not: Explaining debt exposure and financing consequences belongs to RAT8. Legal creditor priority belongs to GOV6.

patterns.name_zh: 计算与识别市场比率
patterns.definition: Identify or calculate earnings per share, price earnings ratio or dividend yield, including weighted average shares and consistent money units.
patterns.not: Investor attractiveness belongs to RAT9. The cancelled all-answer item is isolated in RAT12 rather than EPS evidence.

patterns.name_zh: 解释流动性与现金约束
patterns.definition: Interpret current and quick ratios or supplied cash-position evidence to explain debt-paying capacity and a business financial constraint.
patterns.not: This is financial analysis, not a legal insolvency determination. Preparing cash movements belongs to CSH or BUD.

patterns.name_en: Interpret efficiency and recommend management action
patterns.name_zh: 解释效率并提出管理改进
patterns.definition: Compare debtor collection or inventory turnover with trends or benchmarks, explain the implication and propose an evidence-linked improvement where requested.
patterns.not: A ratio comparison remains current even when an old question calls the benchmark a KPI; stand-alone obsolete KPI disclosure purposes belong to OUT3.

patterns.name_en: Interpret financial stability and financing risk
patterns.name_zh: 解释财务稳健性与筹资风险
patterns.definition: Use debt, leverage or interest-coverage evidence to explain the company financing risk or ability to support a business decision.
patterns.not: A formula or numerical input alone belongs to RAT4; insolvency procedures belong to GOV.

patterns.name_zh: 评价投资吸引力与盈利表现
patterns.definition: Interpret market or profitability ratios across periods or benchmarks and explain what they suggest to the decision maker.
patterns.not: A single ratio result is not a complete investment recommendation. Capital-project appraisal belongs to INV.

patterns.name_en: Predict transaction effects on financial ratios
patterns.name_zh: 预测交易对财务比率的影响
patterns.definition: Trace how a specified transaction changes numerator, denominator or both to determine the direction of a ratio change.
patterns.not: Do not infer direction from a numerator alone when the denominator also changes. Routine ledger recording belongs to EQT or STM.

patterns.name_zh: 解释财务分析的局限
patterns.definition: Explain a limitation of financial information, ratios or comparisons and connect it to the decision being made.
patterns.not: Merely stating an adverse ratio is interpretation in RAT6–RAT9 rather than a limitation of the method.

patterns.name_zh: 历史取消题：行政给分
patterns.definition: Retain the official all-answer record for the cancelled 2021 item, whose missing date prevents an EPS calculation.
patterns.not: This carries no assessable EPS knowledge or mastery evidence and must be excluded from question generation and diagnostic statistics.

patterns.name_zh: 识别并解释财务报告机构的职责
patterns.definition: Identify or explain the role and importance of ASIC, ASX, AASB, IASB or ISSB in the reporting system.
patterns.not: The general benefits of standards belong to FRM6; removed FRC or lobby-group requirements belong to OUT4.

patterns.name_en: Apply director duties and shareholder rights
patterns.name_zh: 应用董事义务与股东权利
patterns.definition: Identify or explain a director duty, shareholder right or the application of company internal rules to a governance situation.
patterns.not: Company formation and the purpose of constitutions belong to FRM2. Recording shares or dividends belongs to EQT.

patterns.name_en: Explain internal audit and control responses
patterns.name_zh: 解释内部审计与控制改进
patterns.definition: Explain internal audit or identify and describe controls, weaknesses and a business response to an audit finding.
patterns.not: Cash-management controls specifically assessed for cash liquidity belong to FIN5; external assurance belongs to GOV4.

patterns.name_en: Explain external audit and stakeholder assurance
patterns.name_zh: 解释外部审计与利益相关者的鉴证需求
patterns.definition: Explain the independent external auditor role, report reliability and confidence for external users or capital markets.
patterns.not: Internal process review belongs to GOV3. Historical appointment mechanics are not assumed current syllabus requirements.

patterns.name_zh: 评价财务活动中的伦理行为
patterns.definition: Identify and explain an ethical issue in financial dealings, linking conduct to affected people and consequences.
patterns.not: Do not classify a numerical variance as an ethical issue without an assessed conduct argument. Old CSR disclosure requirements belong to OUT1.

patterns.name_zh: 解释无力偿债与债权受偿顺序
patterns.definition: Identify insolvency as inability to pay debts when due or explain the priority of claims in the course scenario.
patterns.not: A poor liquidity ratio alone does not establish legal insolvency. The specific recovery procedures belong to GOV7–GOV9.

patterns.name_zh: 解释自愿托管
patterns.definition: Explain the administration process and its purpose in investigating and resolving company financial difficulties.
patterns.not: Secured-asset recovery belongs to GOV8; winding up belongs to GOV9.

patterns.name_zh: 解释接管
patterns.definition: Explain a receiver realising secured assets for repayment to the secured creditor under the scenario.
patterns.not: Do not treat receivership as an automatic whole-company liquidation, which belongs to GOV9.

patterns.name_zh: 解释清算
patterns.definition: Explain winding up a company, realising assets and addressing creditor claims under the stated procedure.
patterns.not: The rescue or investigation purpose of administration belongs to GOV7; a stand-alone ranking of claims belongs to GOV6.

patterns.name_en: Recognise climate risks, opportunities and emissions scopes
patterns.name_zh: 识别气候风险、机会与排放范围
patterns.definition: Identify or explain the current syllabus climate-related risks and opportunities and distinguish its emissions scopes.
patterns.not: Historical generic CSR discussion is not evidence that a climate-scope award was examined. Disclosure pillars belong to GOV11.

patterns.name_zh: 解释 AASB S2 的披露支柱
patterns.definition: Explain or classify governance, strategy, risk management and metrics and targets in the syllabus climate-related disclosure framework.
patterns.not: Do not invent emissions calculations or infer current AASB S2 coverage from old CSR requirements in OUT1.

patterns.name_zh: 评价可持续性报告声明
patterns.definition: Interpret a reporting entity sustainability disclosures and evaluate evidence of greenwashing or bluewashing.
patterns.not: The superseded list of difficulties producing generic CSR disclosures belongs to OUT1; disclosure-pillar identification belongs to GOV11.

patterns.name_zh: 解释旧大纲的企业社会披露要求
patterns.definition: Answer a standalone historical requirement on corporate social-disclosure examples, users, purposes or preparation difficulties that the current syllabus has removed or replaced.
patterns.not: Current climate-risk, AASB S2 or sustainability-report interpretation belongs to GOV. A social context alone does not make an award historical.

patterns.name_en: Evaluate historical responsible-practice costs and income
patterns.name_zh: 评价旧大纲的责任实践成本与收入
patterns.definition: Answer the historical standalone requirement about costs and potential income from socially or environmentally responsible business practices.
patterns.not: Do not classify ordinary cost calculations or current climate-related opportunity analysis here solely because a responsible-business context is present.

patterns.name_en: Explain historical annual-report and standalone KPI purposes
patterns.name_zh: 解释旧大纲的年报与独立KPI用途
patterns.definition: Explain the superseded standalone annual-report or KPI-purpose requirement, including generic accountability and decision-making roles.
patterns.not: Interpreting an actual efficiency ratio against a benchmark remains RAT; master-budget control remains BUD even when an old question uses the term KPI.

patterns.name_zh: 解释旧大纲的报告机构
patterns.definition: Explain a reporting institution or lobby-group requirement explicitly removed from the current reporting-body list.
patterns.not: ASIC, IASB, ISSB, AASB and ASX roles listed in the current syllabus belong to GOV.

patterns.name_zh: 识别已被替换的融资产品
patterns.definition: Recognise specifically superseded financing notes or trust products when historical practice is requested.
patterns.not: Underlying unsecured borrowing may remain FIN; physical notes and coins are cash, and notes to financial statements remain STM.

patterns.name_zh: 识别历史建议股利处理
patterns.definition: Recognise the historical recommendation-only dividend requirement when explicitly practising superseded content.
patterns.not: Declared or paid dividends remain EQT; a recommendation alone is not a current dividend declaration entry.
